lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments. Spacing is relatively uniform across the central torso, narrowing significantly towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripes 1, 2, 10, and 11 are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the ventral torso line. Stripe 10 is notably shorter than adjacent segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Group of 6-7 high-contrast spots clustered on the posterior haunch and upper-most region of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally, while others appear in a localized triangular cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: Single high-contrast white spot on the lower cheek/mandible. White transverse bands present on the lower carpus and tarsus regions of the limbs.
